role_declaration: Historical edition-assignment records under section 1.3 of the retained 2021 text, not verification of the engineering rules in every historical edition. Recorded dates and editions may be missing or inconsistent; their correctness is not an external assumption.

Edition/application records described by section 1.1 of the retained text. Recorded construction date and provision/edition assertions are values to assess; this declaration does not assume that a date/edition assignment is correct or that every record belongs to the 2021 date interval.

Stored propulsion-power and calculation-reference records. calculatedRequiredPower is a separately supplied engineering calculation result for the represented design; authenticity of that reference is assumed for research rather than recomputing the upstream engineering calculation. Source conditions on the recorded output and class remain in scope.

Stored design-scantling and comparator records for comparable physical scantlings. regulationRequiredScantling and classificationSocietyRequiredScantling are supplied reference quantities, the latter for the corresponding non-ice-strengthened baseline described by the source. The three quantities share a supplied unit within each record; unit identity does not certify engineering equivalence. Their numeric relationship is not assumed true.

Stored compressor charging-time, class and machinery-operation records. These values represent the design claims described in the source; no charging-time condition or branch result is assumed true. Actual machinery performance is not independently measured.

Stored plating thickness, required net-thickness reference and allowance records. The required net-thickness and allowance are supplied engineering references; upstream structural calculations and physical measurements are not reconstructed. Declared property-specific units and represented source conditions remain validation responsibilities.

Finite represented weld records and their recorded area/state attributes. Physical inventory completeness and welding inspection are not independently certified. Recorded applicability/state values may be absent or inconsistent and are not assumed true.

Finite represented pump, containing-compartment and maintained-temperature design records. Physical pump inventories and actual thermal performance are not reconstructed; declared record identities and property mappings are used. The source-defined condition remains for generated validation.

Finite represented passenger and crew inventories with instruction/training completion records for the source-described duties. Completion values are recorded claims, not proof that a person has acquired practical skills. No completion status is assumed true; real-world inventory reconstruction is outside scope.

Finite represented navigation/communication antenna inventories and environmental-state/protection records. Environmental-state and protection values are supplied claims, not assumed compliant or inferred from absence. Physical survey and forecasting are outside scope.

Stored ice-navigation loading records and independently supplied UIWL draught and permitted ice-trim design references. Authenticity of reference limits and environmental observations is assumed for research rather than recomputing waterline geometry or performing a physical survey. Navigation state and recorded loading inputs are not assumed compliant.

Finite represented structural-member and spanned-hull-area records, with supplied area-factor references and recorded selected design factors. Physical survey of actual hull boundaries is outside this research. No required numeric relationship is pre-assumed.

Finite represented member records with stored net web/shell thicknesses and yield-strength inputs. Engineering measurement and material certification are external research assumptions. The represented additional source condition remains in scope; input completeness alone is not compliance.

Stored Table-4-1 design-parameter-set records associated with a ship through the declared hasIceClassDesignParameterSet relationship. These are design parameters, not measured ambient sea-ice conditions. The complete admitted population is the supplied parameter-set class; parent relationships and recorded class inputs remain subject to validation. No behavior for source-ambiguous non-table classes is certified by this finite pilot.

Stored frame-attachment records linked to their frames through the declared frameAttachment relationship. The complete admitted population is the attachment-record class, including records with missing or inconsistent fields. Physical fabrication inspection is outside scope; source conditions, relationship completeness and exceptions remain validation responsibilities.

General Table-8 material-selection records for represented plating/design cases. Authenticity of the supplied design/material references is a research assumption. The discretionary special single-strake allowance in Table-8 footnote 2 is outside this proposed research population; no conclusion is claimed for that exception. Selector/grade correctness is not assumed true, and all represented source conditions remain in scope.
